     ========================================================================== */
  var JuegoEngranajes = {
    container: null,
    currentStep: 0,
    selectedOption: null,
    isSpinning: false,
    leoMood: 'descubrimiento',
    coachMsg: 'Nora necesita activar los engranajes de la fábrica. ¡Elige una opción y pulsa ENCENDER FÁBRICA!',
    stepCompleted: [false, false, false],

    challenges: [
      {
        id: 'engranaje_reto_1',
        badgeText: 'Reto 1 de 3 · Descubre el sentido de giro',
        prompt: 'Si el primer engranaje gira hacia la derecha, ¿hacia dónde gira el segundo engranaje que está en contacto directo?',
        sceneType: 'two_contact',
        options: [
          { text: 'Hacia la derecha.', correct: false },
          { text: 'Hacia la izquierda.', correct: true }
        ],
        successMsg: '¡Correcto! Dos engranajes en contacto directo giran siempre en sentidos opuestos.',
        errorMsg: '¡Observa los dientes! Cuando el primero empuja hacia abajo en el centro, hace girar al segundo en sentido contrario.'
      },
      {
        id: 'engranaje_reto_2',
        badgeText: 'Reto 2 de 3 · Conecta los engranajes',
        prompt: 'Selecciona la configuración que permite conectar correctamente las ruedas dentadas para activar la máquina:',
        sceneType: 'connect_slot',
        options: [
          { text: 'Configuración 1: Engranaje central engranado tocando ambos dientes.', correct: true },
          { text: 'Configuración 2: Engranaje central separado arriba sin contacto.', correct: false }
        ],
        successMsg: '¡La fábrica está funcionando! Los tres engranajes transmiten el movimiento hasta la máquina.',
        errorMsg: '¡Los dientes no se tocan! Elige la configuración que encaja las ruedas dentadas entre sí.'
      },
      {
        id: 'engranaje_reto_3',
        badgeText: 'Reto 3 de 3 · Controla la velocidad',
        prompt: 'Si un engranaje pequeño mueve uno grande, ¿cómo gira el engranaje grande?',
        sceneType: 'small_to_large',
        options: [
          { text: 'Más lentamente.', correct: true },
          { text: 'Más rápidamente.', correct: false },
          { text: 'A la misma velocidad.', correct: false }
        ],
        successMsg: '¡Excelente! Como el engranaje grande tiene más dientes, tarda más en completar una vuelta y gira más lentamente.',
        errorMsg: '¡Fíjate en el tamaño! El engranaje grande tiene muchos más dientes por recorrer que el pequeño.'
      }
    ],

    init: function () {
      this.container = document.getElementById('juego-engranajes');
      if (!this.container) return;
      this.render();
    },

    renderToothedGearGroup: function (cx, cy, teeth, rOuter, rInner, fill, animClass, label) {
      var polyPoints = createGearPolygonPoints(cx, cy, teeth, rOuter, rInner);
      return (
        '<g class="gear-rotatable ' + (animClass || '') + '">' +
          '<polygon points="' + polyPoints + '" fill="' + fill + '" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
          '<line x1="' + (cx - rInner + 8) + '" y1="' + cy + '" x2="' + (cx + rInner - 8) + '" y2="' + cy + '" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
          '<line x1="' + cx + '" y1="' + (cy - rInner + 8) + '" x2="' + cx + '" y2="' + (cy + rInner - 8) + '" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
          '<circle cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="' + Math.round(rInner * 0.32) + '" fill="#FFF8E9" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
        '</g>' +
        (label ? '<text x="' + cx + '" y="' + (cy + rOuter + 24) + '" text-anchor="middle" fill="#173B57" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">' + label + '</text>' : '')
      );
    },

    getStageSvg: function (ch) {
      var spin = this.isSpinning;
      if (ch.sceneType === 'two_contact') {
        var g1Anim = spin ? 'gear-spin-cw' : '';
        var g2Anim = spin ? 'gear-spin-ccw' : '';
        return (
          '<svg viewBox="0 0 720 265" width="720" height="265" role="img" aria-label="Dos engranajes con dientes visibles en contacto directo.">' +
            '<rect width="720" height="265" rx="16" fill="#FFF8E9"/>' +
            '<rect x="95" y="20" width="530" height="225" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
            this.renderToothedGearGroup(292, 122, 12, 66, 52, '#39B8AE', g1Anim, '1. MOTOR (Derecha ↻)') +
            this.renderToothedGearGroup(418, 122, 12, 66, 52, '#F28C45', g2Anim, '2. ENGRANAJE EN CONTACTO') +
          '</svg>'
        );
      }

      if (ch.sceneType === 'connect_slot') {
        var middleConnected = this.selectedOption !== 1;
        var midY = middleConnected ? 122 : 52;
        var motorAnim = spin ? 'gear-spin-cw' : '';
        var midAnim = (spin && middleConnected) ? 'gear-spin-ccw' : '';
        var outAnim = (spin && middleConnected) ? 'gear-spin-cw' : '';
        var machineLight = (spin && middleConnected) ? '#39B8AE' : '#D5E2EC';
        var machineText = (spin && middleConnected) ? '¡FÁBRICA ACTIVA!' : 'EN ESPERA';

        return (
          '<svg viewBox="0 0 720 265" width="720" height="265" role="img" aria-label="Sistema de tres engranajes con dientes conectando el motor y la máquina de la fábrica.">' +
            '<rect width="720" height="265" rx="16" fill="#FFF8E9"/>' +
            '<rect x="40" y="20" width="640" height="225" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
            '<circle cx="305" cy="122" r="50" fill="none" stroke="#39B8AE" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="7,5"/>' +
            this.renderToothedGearGroup(192, 122, 11, 58, 45, '#39B8AE', motorAnim, '1. MOTOR') +
            this.renderToothedGearGroup(305, midY, 10, 54, 42, '#FFC857', midAnim, middleConnected ? '2. CONECTADO' : '2. SEPARADO') +
            this.renderToothedGearGroup(418, 122, 11, 58, 45, '#F28C45', outAnim, '3. SALIDA') +
            '<rect x="515" y="68" width="135" height="108" rx="14" fill="#173B57"/>' +
            '<circle cx="582" cy="108" r="20" fill="' + machineLight + '" stroke="#FFF8E9" stroke-width="3"/>' +
            '<text x="582" y="154" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFC857" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">' + machineText + '</text>' +
          '</svg>'
        );
      }

      var smallAnim = spin ? 'gear-spin-cw-fast' : '';
      var largeAnim = spin ? 'gear-spin-ccw-slow' : '';
      return (
        '<svg viewBox="0 0 720 265" width="720" height="265" role="img" aria-label="Engranaje pequeño moviendo un engranaje grande con dientes visibles.">' +
          '<rect width="720" height="265" rx="16" fill="#FFF8E9"/>' +
          '<rect x="95" y="18" width="530" height="228" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
          this.renderToothedGearGroup(272, 122, 8, 44, 33, '#FFC857', smallAnim, 'PEQUEÑO (Rápido ↻)') +
          this.renderToothedGearGroup(396, 122, 16, 82, 68, '#39B8AE', largeAnim, 'GRANDE (Más lento ↺)') +
        '</svg>'
      );
    },

    render: function () {
      if (!this.container) return;
      var self = this;
      var ch = this.challenges[this.currentStep];

      var optionsHtml = ch.options.map(function (opt, idx) {
        var selClass = self.selectedOption === idx ? ' is-selected' : '';
        var pressed = self.selectedOption === idx ? 'true' : 'false';
        return (
          '<button type="button" class="ia-option-btn' + selClass + '" data-opt-index="' + idx + '" aria-pressed="' + pressed + '">' +
            opt.text +
          '</button>'
        );
      }).join('');

      var allDone = this.stepCompleted[0] && this.stepCompleted[1] && this.stepCompleted[2];
      var badgeBanner = allDone ? (
        '<div class="ia-badge-unlocked-banner" role="status">' +
          '<h4>🏅 ¡Insignia obtenida: EXPERTO EN ENGRANAJES!</h4>' +
          '<p>Has puesto en marcha toda la fábrica junto a Nora y Leo.</p>' +
        '</div>'
      ) : '';

      this.container.innerHTML =
        '<div class="ia-game-header">' +
          '<h3 class="ia-game-title">⚙️ JUEGO 3: ¡ACTIVA LA FÁBRICA!</h3>' +
          '<span class="ia-game-step-badge">' + ch.badgeText + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-character-coach">' +
          '<div class="ia-coach-avatar">' + getLeoAvatarSvg(this.leoMood) + '</div>' +
          '<div class="ia-coach-bubble">' +
            '<span class="ia-coach-name">Leo y Nora · Fábrica de Engranajes</span>' +
            '<p class="ia-coach-text">' + this.coachMsg + '</p>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-game-prompt">' + ch.prompt + '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-game-stage" id="engranaje-stage">' +
          this.getStageSvg(ch) +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-options-grid" role="group" aria-label="Opciones del reto de engranajes">' +
          optionsHtml +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-game-actions">' +
          '<button type="button" class="ia-btn ia-btn--primary" id="btn-engranaje-probar">ENCENDER FÁBRICA</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="ia-btn ia-btn--secondary" id="btn-engranaje-reintentar">REINTENTAR</button>' +
          (this.currentStep < this.challenges.length - 1
            ? '<button type="button" class="ia-btn ia-btn--warning" id="btn-engranaje-siguiente" ' + (this.stepCompleted[this.currentStep] ? '' : 'disabled') + '>SIGUIENTE RETO</button>'
            : '') +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="engranaje-feedback" aria-live="polite"></div>' +
        badgeBanner;

      this.bindEvents();
    },

    bindEvents: function () {
      var self = this;
      this.container.querySelectorAll('.ia-option-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          self.selectedOption = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-opt-index'), 10);
          self.isSpinning = false;
          self.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
          self.coachMsg = 'Configuración seleccionada. ¡Pulsa ENCENDER FÁBRICA para probar el giro!';
          self.render();
        });
      });

      var btnProbar = document.getElementById('btn-engranaje-probar');
      if (btnProbar) {
        btnProbar.addEventListener('click', function () { self.comprobar(); });
      }

      var btnReintentar = document.getElementById('btn-engranaje-reintentar');
      if (btnReintentar) {
        btnReintentar.addEventListener('click', function () { self.reiniciar(); });
      }

      var btnSiguiente = document.getElementById('btn-engranaje-siguiente');
      if (btnSiguiente) {
        btnSiguiente.addEventListener('click', function () {
          if (self.currentStep < self.challenges.length - 1) {
            self.currentStep += 1;
            self.selectedOption = null;
            self.isSpinning = false;
            self.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
            self.coachMsg = '¡Siguiente reto de engranajes! Observa el tamaño y la conexión de las ruedas.';
            self.render();
          }
        });
      }
    },

    comprobar: function () {
      var ch = this.challenges[this.currentStep];
      if (this.selectedOption === null) {
        this.leoMood = 'error';
        this.coachMsg = 'Elige primero una opción antes de pulsar ENCENDER FÁBRICA.';
        this.render();
        var fbEmpty = document.getElementById('engranaje-feedback');
        if (fbEmpty) fbEmpty.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-error">Selecciona una opción antes de encender la fábrica.</div>';
        return;
      }

      var chosen = ch.options[this.selectedOption];
      if (chosen && chosen.correct) {
        this.isSpinning = true;
        this.stepCompleted[this.currentStep] = true;
        AppState.awardStar(ch.id);
        var allDone = this.stepCompleted[0] && this.stepCompleted[1] && this.stepCompleted[2];
        if (allDone) {
          AppState.unlockBadge('engranajes');
          this.leoMood = 'felicitacion';
          this.coachMsg = '¡Fábrica en marcha al 100%! Desbloqueaste la insignia EXPERTO EN ENGRANAJES.';
        } else {
          this.leoMood = 'exito';
          this.coachMsg = '¡Mira cómo encajan los dientes y giran las ruedas!';
        }
        this.render();
        var fbAfter = document.getElementById('engranaje-feedback');
        if (fbAfter) {
          fbAfter.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-success">⭐ ' + ch.successMsg + '</div>';
        }
      } else {
        this.isSpinning = false;
        this.leoMood = 'error';
        this.coachMsg = '¡Revisa el contacto y los dientes de las ruedas e inténtalo de nuevo!';
        this.render();
        var fbErr = document.getElementById('engranaje-feedback');
        if (fbErr) {
          fbErr.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-error">' + ch.errorMsg + '</div>';
        }
      }
    },

    reiniciar: function () {
      this.selectedOption = null;
      this.isSpinning = false;
      this.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
      this.coachMsg = 'Engranajes detenidos. Elige una opción y pulsa ENCENDER FÁBRICA.';
      this.render();
    }
  };

  /* ==========================================================================
     PÁGINA 5: MISIÓN FINAL (TRES RETOS UNO A UNO, AVANZA SOLO AL ACERTAR)
     ========================================================================== */
  var GranMisionFinal = {
    container: null,
    currentStep: 0,
    selectedOption: null,
    currentStepSolved: false,
    leoMood: 'descubrimiento',
    coachMsg: 'Observa la ilustración de este desafío y elige la máquina simple correcta.',
    finishedAll: false,

    challenges: [
      {
        id: 'mision_final_1',
        badgeText: 'Reto Final 1 de 3',
        imgFile: 'ilustracion_mision_reto1.svg',
        imgAlt: 'Imagen de una piedra pesada que debe levantarse con una barra y un punto de apoyo.',
        prompt: '¿Qué máquina simple utilizarías?',
        options: [
          { text: 'Palanca.', correct: true },
          { text: 'Polea.', correct: false },
          { text: 'Engranajes.', correct: false }
        ],
        successMsg: '¡Correcto! La palanca apoyada en un punto de apoyo permite levantar la piedra pesada.',
        errorMsg: 'Observa la barra rígida apoyada sobre la piedra pequeña. ¡Inténtalo de nuevo!'
      },
      {
        id: 'mision_final_2',
        badgeText: 'Reto Final 2 de 3',
        imgFile: 'ilustracion_mision_reto2.svg',
        imgAlt: 'Imagen de una carga suspendida de una cuerda y una rueda.',
        prompt: '¿Qué mecanismo permite levantar la carga?',
        options: [
          { text: 'Engranajes.', correct: false },
          { text: 'Polea.', correct: true },
          { text: 'Palanca.', correct: false }
        ],
        successMsg: '¡Correcto! La polea utiliza una rueda acanalada y una cuerda para izar la carga.',
        errorMsg: 'Fíjate en la cuerda que pasa por la rueda superior. ¡Vuelve a intentarlo!'
      },
      {
        id: 'mision_final_3',
        badgeText: 'Reto Final 3 de 3',
        imgFile: 'ilustracion_mision_reto3.svg',
        imgAlt: 'Imagen de dos ruedas dentadas en contacto.',
        prompt: '¿Qué mecanismo transmite el movimiento?',
        options: [
          { text: 'Polea.', correct: false },
          { text: 'Palanca.', correct: false },
          { text: 'Engranajes.', correct: true }
        ],
        successMsg: '¡Correcto! Los engranajes son ruedas dentadas que transmiten el movimiento entre sí.',
        errorMsg: 'Observa los dientes de las dos ruedas conectadas. ¡Elige otra opción y pulsa COMPROBAR!'
      }
    ],

    init: function () {
      this.container = document.getElementById('juego-mision-final');
      if (!this.container) return;
      this.render();
    },

    getResPrefix: function () {
      return this.container && this.container.getAttribute('data-res-prefix')
        ? this.container.getAttribute('data-res-prefix')
        : '../content/resources/';
    },

    render: function () {
      if (!this.container) return;
      var self = this;
      var resPrefix = this.getResPrefix();

      if (this.finishedAll) {
        AppState.data.finalMissionScore = 3;
        AppState.data.finalMissionCompleted = true;
        AppState.save();

        this.container.innerHTML =
          '<div class="ia-game-header">' +
            '<h3 class="ia-game-title">🏆 ¡MISIÓN FINAL SUPERADA!</h3>' +
            '<span class="ia-game-step-badge">3 de 3 Estrellas de Misión</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="ia-character-coach">' +
            '<div class="ia-coach-avatar">' + getLeoAvatarSvg('felicitacion') + '</div>' +
            '<div class="ia-coach-bubble">' +
              '<span class="ia-coach-name">Leo, Maya, Bruno y Nora</span>' +
              '<p class="ia-coach-text">¡Increíble! Has resuelto los 3 retos del taller y demostrado que eres un inventor experto.</p>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-success" style="margin-bottom:20px;">' +
            '⭐⭐⭐ ¡Has obtenido las 3 estrellas de la Misión Final!' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="ia-game-actions">' +
            '<button type="button" class="ia-btn ia-btn--secondary" id="btn-mision-repetir-todo">REINTENTAR MISIÓN</button>' +
            '<a href="final-inventor-experto.html" class="ia-btn ia-btn--primary">VER MIS RECOMPENSAS</a>' +
            '<a href="../index.html" class="ia-btn ia-btn--warning">VOLVER AL INICIO</a>' +
          '</div>';

        var btnRepeatAll = document.getElementById('btn-mision-repetir-todo');
        if (btnRepeatAll) {
          btnRepeatAll.addEventListener('click', function () {
            self.currentStep = 0;
            self.selectedOption = null;
            self.currentStepSolved = false;
            self.finishedAll = false;
            self.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
            self.coachMsg = 'Observa la ilustración de este desafío y elige la máquina simple correcta.';
            self.render();
          });
        }
        return;
      }

      var ch = this.challenges[this.currentStep];
      var optionsHtml = ch.options.map(function (opt, idx) {
        var selClass = self.selectedOption === idx ? ' is-selected' : '';
        var pressed = self.selectedOption === idx ? 'true' : 'false';
        return (
          '<button type="button" class="ia-option-btn' + selClass + '" data-opt-index="' + idx + '" aria-pressed="' + pressed + '">' +
            opt.text +
          '</button>'
        );
      }).join('');

      var nextLabel = this.currentStep < this.challenges.length - 1 ? 'SIGUIENTE RETO' : 'COMPLETAR MISIÓN';

      this.container.innerHTML =
        '<div class="ia-game-header">' +
          '<h3 class="ia-game-title">🚨 MISIÓN FINAL: ¡DEMUESTRA QUE ERES UN INVENTOR EXPERTO!</h3>' +
          '<span class="ia-game-step-badge">' + ch.badgeText + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-character-coach">' +
          '<div class="ia-coach-avatar">' + getLeoAvatarSvg(this.leoMood) + '</div>' +
          '<div class="ia-coach-bubble">' +
            '<span class="ia-coach-name">Leo · Misión Final del Taller</span>' +
            '<p class="ia-coach-text">' + this.coachMsg + '</p>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-illustration-box">' +
          '<img src="' + resPrefix + ch.imgFile + '" alt="' + ch.imgAlt + '" width="780" height="300"/>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-game-prompt">' + ch.prompt + '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-options-grid" role="group" aria-label="Opciones del reto final">' +
          optionsHtml +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-game-actions">' +
          '<button type="button" class="ia-btn ia-btn--primary" id="btn-mision-comprobar">COMPROBAR</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="ia-btn ia-btn--secondary" id="btn-mision-reintentar">REINTENTAR</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="ia-btn ia-btn--warning" id="btn-mision-siguiente" ' + (this.currentStepSolved ? '' : 'disabled') + '>' + nextLabel + '</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="mision-feedback" aria-live="polite"></div>';

      this.bindEvents();
    },

    bindEvents: function () {
      var self = this;
      this.container.querySelectorAll('.ia-option-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          self.selectedOption = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-opt-index'), 10);
          self.currentStepSolved = false;
          self.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
          self.coachMsg = 'Opción seleccionada. Pulsa COMPROBAR para verificar tu respuesta.';
          self.render();
        });
      });

      var btnComprobar = document.getElementById('btn-mision-comprobar');
      if (btnComprobar) {
        btnComprobar.addEventListener('click', function () { self.comprobar(); });
      }

      var btnReintentar = document.getElementById('btn-mision-reintentar');
      if (btnReintentar) {
        btnReintentar.addEventListener('click', function () { self.reiniciar(); });
      }

      var btnSiguiente = document.getElementById('btn-mision-siguiente');
      if (btnSiguiente) {
        btnSiguiente.addEventListener('click', function () {
          if (!self.currentStepSolved) return;
          if (self.currentStep < self.challenges.length - 1) {
            self.currentStep += 1;
            self.selectedOption = null;
            self.currentStepSolved = false;
            self.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
            self.coachMsg = '¡Avanzas al siguiente reto! Observa la nueva situación y elige tu respuesta.';
            self.render();
          } else {
            self.finishedAll = true;
            self.render();
          }
        });
      }
    },

    comprobar: function () {
      var ch = this.challenges[this.currentStep];
      if (this.selectedOption === null) {
        this.leoMood = 'error';
        this.coachMsg = 'Selecciona una máquina simple antes de pulsar COMPROBAR.';
        this.render();
        var fbEmpty = document.getElementById('mision-feedback');
        if (fbEmpty) fbEmpty.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-error">Elige una de las tres opciones antes de comprobar.</div>';
        return;
      }

      var chosen = ch.options[this.selectedOption];
      if (chosen && chosen.correct) {
        this.currentStepSolved = true;
        AppState.awardStar(ch.id);
        this.leoMood = 'exito';
        this.coachMsg = '¡Respuesta correcta! Ya puedes avanzar al siguiente reto.';
        this.render();
        var fbOk = document.getElementById('mision-feedback');
        if (fbOk) fbOk.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-success">⭐ ' + ch.successMsg + '</div>';
      } else {
        this.currentStepSolved = false;
        this.leoMood = 'error';
        this.coachMsg = 'No es ese mecanismo. ¡Observa los detalles de la imagen y vuelve a intentarlo!';
        this.render();
        var fbErr = document.getElementById('mision-feedback');
        if (fbErr) fbErr.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-error">' + ch.errorMsg + '</div>';
      }
    },

    reiniciar: function () {
      this.selectedOption = null;
      this.currentStepSolved = false;
      this.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
      this.coachMsg = 'Reto reiniciado. Selecciona un mecanismo y pulsa COMPROBAR.';
      this.render();
    }
  };

  /* ==========================================================================
     PÁGINA 6: MISIÓN CUMPLIDA (RECOMPENSAS, ESTRELLAS Y REINICIO)
     ========================================================================== */
  var PantallaFinalExperto = {
    init: function () {
      var panel = document.getElementById('ia-final-summary');
      if (!panel) return;

      var totalStars = AppState.getStarCount();
      var bPalancas = !!AppState.data.badges.palancas;
      var bPoleas = !!AppState.data.badges.poleas;
      var bEngranajes = !!AppState.data.badges.engranajes;
      var missionScore = AppState.data.finalMissionScore || 0;

      var starsEl = document.getElementById('ia-final-stars-total');
      if (starsEl) {
        starsEl.textContent = totalStars + ' de 12 estrellas obtenidas en el taller';
      }

      var missionEl = document.getElementById('ia-final-mission-status');
      if (missionEl) {
        missionEl.textContent = missionScore === 3
          ? '¡Increíble! Has superado los 3 retos de la Misión Final y salvado el taller.'
          : 'Estrellas de la Misión Final: ' + missionScore + ' de 3.';
      }

      this.updateBadgeCard('card-badge-palancas', bPalancas);
      this.updateBadgeCard('card-badge-poleas', bPoleas);
      this.updateBadgeCard('card-badge-engranajes', bEngranajes);

      var btnResetPlay = document.getElementById('btn-volver-a-jugar');
      if (btnResetPlay && btnResetPlay.getAttribute('data-ia-bound') !== '1') {
        btnResetPlay.setAttribute('data-ia-bound', '1');
        btnResetPlay.addEventListener('click', function () {
          AppState.resetAll();
          var isRoot = window.location.pathname.indexOf('/html/') === -1 && window.location.pathname.indexOf('\\html\\') === -1;
          window.location.href = isRoot ? 'index.html' : '../index.html';
        });
      }
    },

    updateBadgeCard: function (id, unlocked) {
      var card = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!card) return;
      card.classList.toggle('is-earned', unlocked);
      var status = card.querySelector('.ia-reward-status');
      if (status) {
        status.textContent = unlocked ? '¡Insignia desbloqueada!' : 'Supera los 3 retos del nivel para ganarla';
      }
    }
  };

  /* ==========================================================================
     INICIALIZACIÓN UNIVERSAL Y OBSERVADOR DE RE-RENDERIZADO DE EXELEARNING
     ========================================================================== */
  function bootAll() {
    AppState.load();
    ControladorAudio.init();
    ControladorInicio.init();
    JuegoPalancas.init();
    JuegoPoleas.init();
    JuegoEngranajes.init();
    GranMisionFinal.init();
    PantallaFinalExperto.init();
  }

  window.InventoresApp = {
    bootAll: bootAll,
    AppState: AppState,
    ControladorAudio: ControladorAudio,
    JuegoPalancas: JuegoPalancas,
    JuegoPoleas: JuegoPoleas,
    JuegoEngranajes: JuegoEngranajes,
    GranMisionFinal: GranMisionFinal,
    PantallaFinalExperto: PantallaFinalExperto
  };

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bootAll);
  } else {
    bootAll();
  }

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    setTimeout(bootAll, 120);
    setTimeout(bootAll, 450);
  });
})();

</script>
</p>
</div>

odeComponent.htmlView:
<div class="exe-text-template">
    <style>
/* ==========================================================================
   INVENTORES EN ACCIÓN: EL MUNDO DE LAS MÁQUINAS SIMPLES
   Sistema de Diseño Editorial de Taller de Inventos (6.° y 7.° Grado)
   Paleta conceptual oficial:
   - Azul petróleo: #173B57 (Elementos estructurales y títulos)
   - Turquesa:      #39B8AE (Interacción y elementos destacados)
   - Amarillo:      #FFC857 (Descubrimientos y recompensas)
   - Naranja:       #F28C45 (Acciones y elementos importantes)
   - Crema:         #FFF8E9 (Fondos cálidos)
   - Blanco:        #FFFFFF (Áreas de lectura)
   - Gris oscuro:   #303943 (Texto)
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --ia-petroleo: #173B57;
  --ia-petroleo-dark: #0F283C;
  --ia-petroleo-mid: #214F73;
  --ia-turquesa: #39B8AE;
  --ia-turquesa-soft: #E5F7F5;
  --ia-amarillo: #FFC857;
  --ia-amarillo-soft: #FFF4D4;
  --ia-naranja: #F28C45;
  --ia-naranja-soft: #FDECE0;
  --ia-crema: #FFF8E9;
  --ia-crema-warm: #F6EAD1;
  --ia-blanco: #FFFFFF;
  --ia-texto: #303943;
  --ia-borde: #C7D8E6;
  --ia-font: 'Segoe UI', 'Nunito', 'Rubik', 'Trebuchet MS', system-ui, sans-serif;
}

/* Fondo general con textura sutil de mesa y plano de taller (nunca blanco plano ni un único color uniforme) */
html,
body,
.exe-export,
#exe-content,
.exe-content,
main,
.container {
  background-color: var(--ia-crema) !important;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 10%, rgba(255, 200, 87, 0.16) 0%, transparent 35%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 85%, rgba(57, 184, 174, 0.14) 0%, transparent 40%),
    linear-gradient(rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px) !important;
  background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 32px 32px, 32px 32px !important;
  color: var(--ia-texto) !important;
  font-family: var(--ia-font) !important;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.58;
}

/* Enlace accesible de salto al contenido */
.ia-skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -120px;
  left: 16px;
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  z-index: 9999;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.ia-skip-link:focus {
  top: 14px;
}

/* Indicador de foco accesible para navegación por teclado */
a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
summary:focus-visible,
[tabindex]:focus-visible {
  outline: 4px solid var(--ia-naranja) !important;
  outline-offset: 3px !important;
}

/* Cabecera del paquete y menú lateral/superior de eXeLearning */
.main-header,
header#header,
.exe-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 65%, var(--ia-petroleo-mid) 100%) !important;
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  border-bottom: 5px solid var(--ia-amarillo) !important;
  border-radius: 0 0 22px 22px;
  padding: 18px 24px !important;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.18);
}

.package-title,
header#header h1 {
  color: var(--ia-amarillo) !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  font-size: 1.85rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  margin: 0 0 4px !important;
}

.package-subtitle {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 1.05rem !important;
  opacity: 0.95;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.page-header .page-title {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  background: rgba(57, 184, 174, 0.22);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: 1.35rem !important;
  margin-top: 12px !important;
}

#siteNav {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo) !important;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

#siteNav ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

#siteNav a {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  font-weight: 800;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 9px 14px !important;
  display: inline-block;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.12s ease;
}

#siteNav a:hover,
#siteNav li.active > a,
#siteNav a.active {
  background-color: var(--ia-turquesa) !important;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

/* Contenedor editorial del taller */
.ia-taller-wrap {
  max-width: 980px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 8px 12px 28px;
}

/* Barra superior de progreso, estrellas e insignias */
.ia-topbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 100%);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  padding: 14px 22px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 0 rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.24);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.ia-brand {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ia-brand-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.ia-brand-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  color: #E5F7F5;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ia-progress-summary {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-star-pill {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  padding: 7px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-blanco);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.ia-badges-mini {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.ia-badge-chip {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  color: #D9E8F5;
  border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

.ia-badge-chip.is-unlocked {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
}

/* Escenarios de historia y lectura del taller */
.ia-card {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 26px 30px;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.14);
  position: relative;
}

.ia-card--highlight {
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #FFFDF7 100%);
}

/* Etiqueta de estación / personaje secundario */
.ia-station-banner {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--ia-petroleo);
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.ia-page-title {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 2.05rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.ia-section-title {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-lead-text {
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
  margin: 0 0 14px;
}

.ia-question-call {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-naranja);
  margin: 12px 0 18px;
}

/* Marco escénico de ilustraciones */
.ia-illustration-box {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ia-crema) 0%, var(--ia-crema-warm) 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 14px;
  margin: 16px 0 20px;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.08);
}

.ia-illustration-box img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 14px;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Tarjetas comparativas de conceptos */
.ia-concept-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(270px, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 16px;
}

.ia-concept-item {
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  border-left: 8px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
}

.ia-concept-item strong {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   BARRA DE AUDIO ACCESIBLE CON VERIFICACIÓN DE VOZ EN ESPAÑOL
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-audio-bar {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-turquesa-soft) 0%, var(--ia-crema) 100%);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  margin: 16px 0;
}

.ia-audio-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.ia-audio-label {
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ia-audio-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-btn-audio {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 9px 16px;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.ia-btn-audio:hover {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ia-btn-audio--play {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-audio-status {
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.ia-transcripcion {
  margin-top: 10px;
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-borde);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
}

.ia-transcripcion summary {
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.ia-transcripcion p {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   BOTONES TÁCTILES DEL TALLER
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--ia-font);
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 14px 26px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: transform 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease, background-color 0.14s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(2px);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.52;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.ia-btn--primary {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--warning {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--orange {
  background: var(--ia-naranja);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--secondary {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-nav-footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 3px dashed var(--ia-borde);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   CONSOLA DE JUEGOS INTERACTIVOS DEL TALLER + COMPAÑERO LEO CON 4 EXPRESIONES
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-game-box {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #FFFDF8 100%);
  border: 4px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 26px;
  padding: 26px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 0 rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.2);
}

.ia-game-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 100%);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  padding: 16px 22px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  border-bottom: 4px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-game-title {
  font-size: 1.42rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  margin: 0;
}

.ia-game-step-badge {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-blanco);
}

/* Barra de compañero narrativo (Leo + Especialista de nivel) */
.ia-character-coach {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  background: var(--ia-amarillo-soft);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-naranja);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.ia-coach-avatar {
  flex: 0 0 64px;
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.ia-coach-bubble {
  flex: 1;
}

.ia-coach-name {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-naranja);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  display: block;
}

.ia-coach-text {
  font-size: 1.14rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  margin: 2px 0 0;
}

.ia-game-prompt {
  font-size: 1.22rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-left: 8px solid var(--ia-naranja);
  padding: 14px 18px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-game-stage {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFDF7 0%, var(--ia-crema-warm) 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  text-align: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: inset 0 3px 8px rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.1);
}

.ia-game-stage svg {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Botones de selección de opciones en los juegos */
.ia-options-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(225px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-option-btn {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  font-family: var(--ia-font);
  font-size: 1.08rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: center;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.18);
}

.ia-option-btn:hover {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo-soft);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ia-option-btn.is-selected {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  border-color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-option-btn img {
  max-width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto 8px;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.ia-game-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

/* Mensajes de retroalimentación */
.ia-feedback-box {
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  text-align: center;
}

.ia-feedback-box.is-success {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa-soft);
  border-color: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-feedback-box.is-error {
  background: var(--ia-naranja-soft);
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-badge-unlocked-banner {
  margin-top: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ia-amarillo) 0%, #FFE28A 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-badge-unlocked-banner h4 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ANIMACIONES REALES DE MECANISMOS (SVG / CSS)
   ========================================================================== */
.palanca-beam-group,
.palanca-box-group,
.palanca-fulcrum-group,
.palanca-effort-group {
  transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.palanca-beam-group {
  transform-origin: 240px 175px;
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-beam-group {
  transform: rotate(10deg);
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-box-group {
  transform: translateY(-28px);
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-effort-group {
  transform: translateY(24px);
}

@keyframes palancaStrain {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  25% { transform: rotate(2deg); }
  50% { transform: rotate(-1.5deg); }
  75% { transform: rotate(1.5deg); }
}

.stage-palanca-fail .palanca-beam-group {
  animation: palancaStrain 0.55s ease-in-out 2;
}

/* JUEGO 2: POLEAS */
.polea-load-group,
.polea-movable-assembly,
.polea-rope-pull {
  transition: transform 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
}

@keyframes wheelSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.polea-wheel-spin {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.stage-polea-active .polea-wheel-spin {
  animation: wheelSpinCW 1.1s linear 2;
}

.stage-polea-fixed-success .polea-load-group {
  transform: translateY(-88px);
}

.stage-polea-fixed-success .polea-rope-pull {
  transform: translateY(72px);
}

.stage-polea-movable-success .polea-movable-assembly {
  transform: translateY(-88px);
}

.stage-polea-movable-success .polea-rope-pull {
  transform: translateY(-76px);
}

@keyframes poleaFailShake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  30% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
  60% { transform: translateY(0); }
}

.stage-polea-fail .polea-load-group,
.stage-polea-fail .polea-movable-assembly {
  animation: poleaFailShake 0.55s ease-in-out 2;
}

/* JUEGO 3: ENGRANAJES */
@keyframes gearSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes gearSpinCCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(-360deg); }
}

.gear-rotatable {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.gear-spin-cw {
  animation: gearSpinCW 2.6s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-ccw {
  animation: gearSpinCCW 2.6s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-cw-fast {
  animation: gearSpinCW 1.5s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-ccw-slow {
  animation: gearSpinCCW 4.5s linear infinite;
}

/* Recompensas finales */
.ia-rewards-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  margin: 20px 0;
}

.ia-reward-card {
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.14);
}

.ia-reward-card.is-earned {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFDF5 0%, #FFEFA6 100%);
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
}

.ia-reward-icon {
  font-size: 2.6rem;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.ia-reward-name {
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}

.ia-reward-status {
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
}

/* Integración visual de las cajas e iDevices nativos de eXeLearning */
article.box {
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

article.box > .box-head {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo) !important;
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0 !important;
  padding: 12px 20px !important;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
}

article.box > .box-head .box-title {
  color: var(--ia-amarillo) !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  font-size: 1.25rem !important;
}

.idevice_node.form,
.idevice_node.relate,
.idevice_node.trueorfalse,
.idevice_node.scrambled-list {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-top: none;
  border-radius: 0 0 22px 22px;
  padding: 24px 28px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.14);
}

@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .ia-page-title {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
  }
  .ia-card,
  .ia-game-box {
    padding: 16px;
  }
  .ia-btn {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

</style>

<summary>Leer transcripción textual completa del audio</summary>
<p>¡Hola! Soy Maya, encargada de la zona de carga. ¡Tenemos una caja demasiado pesada! ¿Puedes ayudarnos? Una palanca es una barra que gira sobre un punto de apoyo para mover una carga. Sus tres elementos son: el punto de apoyo, la fuerza y la carga.</p>
</details></div>
<p class="ia-lead-text">Una palanca es una barra que gira sobre un punto de apoyo para mover una carga.</p>
<div class="ia-illustration-box"><img src="{{context_path}}/content/resources/ilustracion_palanca_partes.svg" alt="Ilustración de una palanca junto a Maya con sus tres elementos señalados: Punto de apoyo, Fuerza y Carga." width="860" height="330" /></div>
<div class="ia-concept-grid">
<div class="ia-concept-item"><strong>Punto de apoyo.</strong> <span>Soporte fijo sobre el que se apoya y gira la barra rígida.</span></div>
<div class="ia-concept-item"><strong>Fuerza.</strong> <span>Empuje que aplicamos para lograr mover o levantar el objeto.</span></div>
<div class="ia-concept-item"><strong>Carga.</strong> <span>Caja u objeto pesado que necesitamos levantar o desplazar.</span></div>
</div>
</section>
</div>

odeComponent.htmlView:
<div class="exe-text-template">
    <style>
/* ==========================================================================
   INVENTORES EN ACCIÓN: EL MUNDO DE LAS MÁQUINAS SIMPLES
   Sistema de Diseño Editorial de Taller de Inventos (6.° y 7.° Grado)
   Paleta conceptual oficial:
   - Azul petróleo: #173B57 (Elementos estructurales y títulos)
   - Turquesa:      #39B8AE (Interacción y elementos destacados)
   - Amarillo:      #FFC857 (Descubrimientos y recompensas)
   - Naranja:       #F28C45 (Acciones y elementos importantes)
   - Crema:         #FFF8E9 (Fondos cálidos)
   - Blanco:        #FFFFFF (Áreas de lectura)
   - Gris oscuro:   #303943 (Texto)
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --ia-petroleo: #173B57;
  --ia-petroleo-dark: #0F283C;
  --ia-petroleo-mid: #214F73;
  --ia-turquesa: #39B8AE;
  --ia-turquesa-soft: #E5F7F5;
  --ia-amarillo: #FFC857;
  --ia-amarillo-soft: #FFF4D4;
  --ia-naranja: #F28C45;
  --ia-naranja-soft: #FDECE0;
  --ia-crema: #FFF8E9;
  --ia-crema-warm: #F6EAD1;
  --ia-blanco: #FFFFFF;
  --ia-texto: #303943;
  --ia-borde: #C7D8E6;
  --ia-font: 'Segoe UI', 'Nunito', 'Rubik', 'Trebuchet MS', system-ui, sans-serif;
}

/* Fondo general con textura sutil de mesa y plano de taller (nunca blanco plano ni un único color uniforme) */
html,
body,
.exe-export,
#exe-content,
.exe-content,
main,
.container {
  background-color: var(--ia-crema) !important;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 10%, rgba(255, 200, 87, 0.16) 0%, transparent 35%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 85%, rgba(57, 184, 174, 0.14) 0%, transparent 40%),
    linear-gradient(rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px) !important;
  background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 32px 32px, 32px 32px !important;
  color: var(--ia-texto) !important;
  font-family: var(--ia-font) !important;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.58;
}

/* Enlace accesible de salto al contenido */
.ia-skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -120px;
  left: 16px;
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  z-index: 9999;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.ia-skip-link:focus {
  top: 14px;
}

/* Indicador de foco accesible para navegación por teclado */
a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
summary:focus-visible,
[tabindex]:focus-visible {
  outline: 4px solid var(--ia-naranja) !important;
  outline-offset: 3px !important;
}

/* Cabecera del paquete y menú lateral/superior de eXeLearning */
.main-header,
header#header,
.exe-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 65%, var(--ia-petroleo-mid) 100%) !important;
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  border-bottom: 5px solid var(--ia-amarillo) !important;
  border-radius: 0 0 22px 22px;
  padding: 18px 24px !important;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.18);
}

.package-title,
header#header h1 {
  color: var(--ia-amarillo) !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  font-size: 1.85rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  margin: 0 0 4px !important;
}

.package-subtitle {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 1.05rem !important;
  opacity: 0.95;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.page-header .page-title {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  background: rgba(57, 184, 174, 0.22);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: 1.35rem !important;
  margin-top: 12px !important;
}

#siteNav {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo) !important;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

#siteNav ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

#siteNav a {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  font-weight: 800;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 9px 14px !important;
  display: inline-block;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.12s ease;
}

#siteNav a:hover,
#siteNav li.active > a,
#siteNav a.active {
  background-color: var(--ia-turquesa) !important;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

/* Contenedor editorial del taller */
.ia-taller-wrap {
  max-width: 980px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 8px 12px 28px;
}

/* Barra superior de progreso, estrellas e insignias */
.ia-topbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 100%);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  padding: 14px 22px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 0 rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.24);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.ia-brand {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ia-brand-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.ia-brand-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  color: #E5F7F5;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ia-progress-summary {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-star-pill {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  padding: 7px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-blanco);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.ia-badges-mini {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.ia-badge-chip {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  color: #D9E8F5;
  border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

.ia-badge-chip.is-unlocked {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
}

/* Escenarios de historia y lectura del taller */
.ia-card {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 26px 30px;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.14);
  position: relative;
}

.ia-card--highlight {
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #FFFDF7 100%);
}

/* Etiqueta de estación / personaje secundario */
.ia-station-banner {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--ia-petroleo);
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.ia-page-title {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 2.05rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.ia-section-title {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-lead-text {
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
  margin: 0 0 14px;
}

.ia-question-call {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-naranja);
  margin: 12px 0 18px;
}

/* Marco escénico de ilustraciones */
.ia-illustration-box {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ia-crema) 0%, var(--ia-crema-warm) 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 14px;
  margin: 16px 0 20px;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.08);
}

.ia-illustration-box img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 14px;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Tarjetas comparativas de conceptos */
.ia-concept-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(270px, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 16px;
}

.ia-concept-item {
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  border-left: 8px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
}

.ia-concept-item strong {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   BARRA DE AUDIO ACCESIBLE CON VERIFICACIÓN DE VOZ EN ESPAÑOL
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-audio-bar {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-turquesa-soft) 0%, var(--ia-crema) 100%);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  margin: 16px 0;
}

.ia-audio-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.ia-audio-label {
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ia-audio-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-btn-audio {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 9px 16px;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.ia-btn-audio:hover {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ia-btn-audio--play {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-audio-status {
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.ia-transcripcion {
  margin-top: 10px;
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-borde);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
}

.ia-transcripcion summary {
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.ia-transcripcion p {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   BOTONES TÁCTILES DEL TALLER
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--ia-font);
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 14px 26px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: transform 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease, background-color 0.14s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(2px);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.52;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.ia-btn--primary {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--warning {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--orange {
  background: var(--ia-naranja);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--secondary {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-nav-footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 3px dashed var(--ia-borde);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   CONSOLA DE JUEGOS INTERACTIVOS DEL TALLER + COMPAÑERO LEO CON 4 EXPRESIONES
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-game-box {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #FFFDF8 100%);
  border: 4px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 26px;
  padding: 26px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 0 rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.2);
}

.ia-game-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 100%);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  padding: 16px 22px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  border-bottom: 4px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-game-title {
  font-size: 1.42rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  margin: 0;
}

.ia-game-step-badge {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-blanco);
}

/* Barra de compañero narrativo (Leo + Especialista de nivel) */
.ia-character-coach {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  background: var(--ia-amarillo-soft);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-naranja);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.ia-coach-avatar {
  flex: 0 0 64px;
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.ia-coach-bubble {
  flex: 1;
}

.ia-coach-name {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-naranja);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  display: block;
}

.ia-coach-text {
  font-size: 1.14rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  margin: 2px 0 0;
}

.ia-game-prompt {
  font-size: 1.22rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-left: 8px solid var(--ia-naranja);
  padding: 14px 18px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-game-stage {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFDF7 0%, var(--ia-crema-warm) 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  text-align: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: inset 0 3px 8px rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.1);
}

.ia-game-stage svg {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Botones de selección de opciones en los juegos */
.ia-options-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(225px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-option-btn {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  font-family: var(--ia-font);
  font-size: 1.08rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: center;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.18);
}

.ia-option-btn:hover {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo-soft);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ia-option-btn.is-selected {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  border-color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-option-btn img {
  max-width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto 8px;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.ia-game-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

/* Mensajes de retroalimentación */
.ia-feedback-box {
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  text-align: center;
}

.ia-feedback-box.is-success {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa-soft);
  border-color: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-feedback-box.is-error {
  background: var(--ia-naranja-soft);
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-badge-unlocked-banner {
  margin-top: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ia-amarillo) 0%, #FFE28A 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-badge-unlocked-banner h4 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ANIMACIONES REALES DE MECANISMOS (SVG / CSS)
   ========================================================================== */
.palanca-beam-group,
.palanca-box-group,
.palanca-fulcrum-group,
.palanca-effort-group {
  transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.palanca-beam-group {
  transform-origin: 240px 175px;
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-beam-group {
  transform: rotate(10deg);
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-box-group {
  transform: translateY(-28px);
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-effort-group {
  transform: translateY(24px);
}

@keyframes palancaStrain {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  25% { transform: rotate(2deg); }
  50% { transform: rotate(-1.5deg); }
  75% { transform: rotate(1.5deg); }
}

.stage-palanca-fail .palanca-beam-group {
  animation: palancaStrain 0.55s ease-in-out 2;
}

/* JUEGO 2: POLEAS */
.polea-load-group,
.polea-movable-assembly,
.polea-rope-pull {
  transition: transform 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
}

@keyframes wheelSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.polea-wheel-spin {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.stage-polea-active .polea-wheel-spin {
  animation: wheelSpinCW 1.1s linear 2;
}

.stage-polea-fixed-success .polea-load-group {
  transform: translateY(-88px);
}

.stage-polea-fixed-success .polea-rope-pull {
  transform: translateY(72px);
}

.stage-polea-movable-success .polea-movable-assembly {
  transform: translateY(-88px);
}

.stage-polea-movable-success .polea-rope-pull {
  transform: translateY(-76px);
}

@keyframes poleaFailShake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  30% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
  60% { transform: translateY(0); }
}

.stage-polea-fail .polea-load-group,
.stage-polea-fail .polea-movable-assembly {
  animation: poleaFailShake 0.55s ease-in-out 2;
}

/* JUEGO 3: ENGRANAJES */
@keyframes gearSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes gearSpinCCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(-360deg); }
}

.gear-rotatable {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.gear-spin-cw {
  animation: gearSpinCW 2.6s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-ccw {
  animation: gearSpinCCW 2.6s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-cw-fast {
  animation: gearSpinCW 1.5s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-ccw-slow {
  animation: gearSpinCCW 4.5s linear infinite;
}

/* Recompensas finales */
.ia-rewards-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  margin: 20px 0;
}

.ia-reward-card {
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.14);
}

.ia-reward-card.is-earned {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFDF5 0%, #FFEFA6 100%);
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
}

.ia-reward-icon {
  font-size: 2.6rem;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.ia-reward-name {
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}

.ia-reward-status {
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
}

/* Integración visual de las cajas e iDevices nativos de eXeLearning */
article.box {
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

article.box > .box-head {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo) !important;
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0 !important;
  padding: 12px 20px !important;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
}

article.box > .box-head .box-title {

}

.idevice_node.form,
.idevice_node.relate,
.idevice_node.trueorfalse,
.idevice_node.scrambled-list {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);

@media (max-width: 680px) {
