odeComponent.htmlView:
<div class="exe-text-template">
    <style>
/* ==========================================================================
   INVENTORES EN ACCIÓN: EL MUNDO DE LAS MÁQUINAS SIMPLES
   Sistema de Diseño Editorial de Taller de Inventos (6.° y 7.° Grado)
   Paleta conceptual oficial:
   - Azul petróleo: #173B57 (Elementos estructurales y títulos)
   - Turquesa:      #39B8AE (Interacción y elementos destacados)
   - Amarillo:      #FFC857 (Descubrimientos y recompensas)
   - Naranja:       #F28C45 (Acciones y elementos importantes)
   - Crema:         #FFF8E9 (Fondos cálidos)
   - Blanco:        #FFFFFF (Áreas de lectura)
   - Gris oscuro:   #303943 (Texto)
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --ia-petroleo: #173B57;
  --ia-petroleo-dark: #0F283C;
  --ia-petroleo-mid: #214F73;
  --ia-turquesa: #39B8AE;
  --ia-turquesa-soft: #E5F7F5;
  --ia-amarillo: #FFC857;
  --ia-amarillo-soft: #FFF4D4;
  --ia-naranja: #F28C45;
  --ia-naranja-soft: #FDECE0;
  --ia-crema: #FFF8E9;
  --ia-crema-warm: #F6EAD1;
  --ia-blanco: #FFFFFF;
  --ia-texto: #303943;
  --ia-borde: #C7D8E6;
  --ia-font: 'Segoe UI', 'Nunito', 'Rubik', 'Trebuchet MS', system-ui, sans-serif;
}

/* Fondo general con textura sutil de mesa y plano de taller (nunca blanco plano ni un único color uniforme) */
html,
body,
.exe-export,
#exe-content,
.exe-content,
main,
.container {
  background-color: var(--ia-crema) !important;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 10%, rgba(255, 200, 87, 0.16) 0%, transparent 35%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 85%, rgba(57, 184, 174, 0.14) 0%, transparent 40%),
    linear-gradient(rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px) !important;
  background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 32px 32px, 32px 32px !important;
  color: var(--ia-texto) !important;
  font-family: var(--ia-font) !important;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.58;
}

/* Enlace accesible de salto al contenido */
.ia-skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -120px;
  left: 16px;
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  z-index: 9999;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.ia-skip-link:focus {
  top: 14px;
}

/* Indicador de foco accesible para navegación por teclado */
a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
summary:focus-visible,
[tabindex]:focus-visible {
  outline: 4px solid var(--ia-naranja) !important;
  outline-offset: 3px !important;
}

/* Cabecera del paquete y menú lateral/superior de eXeLearning */
.main-header,
header#header,
.exe-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 65%, var(--ia-petroleo-mid) 100%) !important;
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  border-bottom: 5px solid var(--ia-amarillo) !important;
  border-radius: 0 0 22px 22px;
  padding: 18px 24px !important;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.18);
}

.package-title,
header#header h1 {
  color: var(--ia-amarillo) !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  font-size: 1.85rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  margin: 0 0 4px !important;
}

.package-subtitle {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 1.05rem !important;
  opacity: 0.95;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.page-header .page-title {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  background: rgba(57, 184, 174, 0.22);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: 1.35rem !important;
  margin-top: 12px !important;
}

#siteNav {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo) !important;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

#siteNav ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

#siteNav a {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  font-weight: 800;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 9px 14px !important;
  display: inline-block;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.12s ease;
}

#siteNav a:hover,
#siteNav li.active > a,
#siteNav a.active {
  background-color: var(--ia-turquesa) !important;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

/* Contenedor editorial del taller */
.ia-taller-wrap {
  max-width: 980px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 8px 12px 28px;
}

/* Barra superior de progreso, estrellas e insignias */
.ia-topbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 100%);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  padding: 14px 22px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 0 rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.24);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.ia-brand {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ia-brand-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.ia-brand-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  color: #E5F7F5;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ia-progress-summary {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-star-pill {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  padding: 7px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-blanco);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.ia-badges-mini {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.ia-badge-chip {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  color: #D9E8F5;
  border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

.ia-badge-chip.is-unlocked {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
}

/* Escenarios de historia y lectura del taller */
.ia-card {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 26px 30px;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.14);
  position: relative;
}

.ia-card--highlight {
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #FFFDF7 100%);
}

/* Etiqueta de estación / personaje secundario */
.ia-station-banner {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--ia-petroleo);
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.ia-page-title {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 2.05rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.ia-section-title {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-lead-text {
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
  margin: 0 0 14px;
}

.ia-question-call {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-naranja);
  margin: 12px 0 18px;
}

/* Marco escénico de ilustraciones */
.ia-illustration-box {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ia-crema) 0%, var(--ia-crema-warm) 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 14px;
  margin: 16px 0 20px;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.08);
}

.ia-illustration-box img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 14px;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Tarjetas comparativas de conceptos */
.ia-concept-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(270px, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 16px;
}

.ia-concept-item {
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  border-left: 8px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
}

.ia-concept-item strong {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   BARRA DE AUDIO ACCESIBLE CON VERIFICACIÓN DE VOZ EN ESPAÑOL
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-audio-bar {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-turquesa-soft) 0%, var(--ia-crema) 100%);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  margin: 16px 0;
}

.ia-audio-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.ia-audio-label {
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ia-audio-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-btn-audio {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 9px 16px;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.ia-btn-audio:hover {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ia-btn-audio--play {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-audio-status {
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.ia-transcripcion {
  margin-top: 10px;
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-borde);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
}

.ia-transcripcion summary {
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.ia-transcripcion p {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   BOTONES TÁCTILES DEL TALLER
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--ia-font);
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 14px 26px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: transform 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease, background-color 0.14s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(2px);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.52;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.ia-btn--primary {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--warning {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--orange {
  background: var(--ia-naranja);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--secondary {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-nav-footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 3px dashed var(--ia-borde);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   CONSOLA DE JUEGOS INTERACTIVOS DEL TALLER + COMPAÑERO LEO CON 4 EXPRESIONES
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-game-box {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #FFFDF8 100%);
  border: 4px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 26px;
  padding: 26px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 0 rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.2);
}

.ia-game-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 100%);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  padding: 16px 22px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  border-bottom: 4px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-game-title {
  font-size: 1.42rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  margin: 0;
}

.ia-game-step-badge {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-blanco);
}

/* Barra de compañero narrativo (Leo + Especialista de nivel) */
.ia-character-coach {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  background: var(--ia-amarillo-soft);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-naranja);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.ia-coach-avatar {
  flex: 0 0 64px;
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.ia-coach-bubble {
  flex: 1;
}

.ia-coach-name {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-naranja);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  display: block;
}

.ia-coach-text {
  font-size: 1.14rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  margin: 2px 0 0;
}

.ia-game-prompt {
  font-size: 1.22rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-left: 8px solid var(--ia-naranja);
  padding: 14px 18px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-game-stage {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFDF7 0%, var(--ia-crema-warm) 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  text-align: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: inset 0 3px 8px rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.1);
}

.ia-game-stage svg {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Botones de selección de opciones en los juegos */
.ia-options-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(225px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-option-btn {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  font-family: var(--ia-font);
  font-size: 1.08rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: center;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.18);
}

.ia-option-btn:hover {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo-soft);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ia-option-btn.is-selected {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  border-color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-option-btn img {
  max-width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto 8px;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.ia-game-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

/* Mensajes de retroalimentación */
.ia-feedback-box {
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  text-align: center;
}

.ia-feedback-box.is-success {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa-soft);
  border-color: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-feedback-box.is-error {
  background: var(--ia-naranja-soft);
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-badge-unlocked-banner {
  margin-top: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ia-amarillo) 0%, #FFE28A 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-badge-unlocked-banner h4 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ANIMACIONES REALES DE MECANISMOS (SVG / CSS)
   ========================================================================== */
.palanca-beam-group,
.palanca-box-group,
.palanca-fulcrum-group,
.palanca-effort-group {
  transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.palanca-beam-group {
  transform-origin: 240px 175px;
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-beam-group {
  transform: rotate(10deg);
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-box-group {
  transform: translateY(-28px);
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-effort-group {
  transform: translateY(24px);
}

@keyframes palancaStrain {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  25% { transform: rotate(2deg); }
  50% { transform: rotate(-1.5deg); }
  75% { transform: rotate(1.5deg); }
}

.stage-palanca-fail .palanca-beam-group {
  animation: palancaStrain 0.55s ease-in-out 2;
}

/* JUEGO 2: POLEAS */
.polea-load-group,
.polea-movable-assembly,
.polea-rope-pull {
  transition: transform 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
}

@keyframes wheelSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.polea-wheel-spin {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.stage-polea-active .polea-wheel-spin {
  animation: wheelSpinCW 1.1s linear 2;
}

.stage-polea-fixed-success .polea-load-group {
  transform: translateY(-88px);
}

.stage-polea-fixed-success .polea-rope-pull {
  transform: translateY(72px);
}

.stage-polea-movable-success .polea-movable-assembly {
  transform: translateY(-88px);
}

.stage-polea-movable-success .polea-rope-pull {
  transform: translateY(-76px);
}

@keyframes poleaFailShake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  30% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
  60% { transform: translateY(0); }
}

.stage-polea-fail .polea-load-group,
.stage-polea-fail .polea-movable-assembly {
  animation: poleaFailShake 0.55s ease-in-out 2;
}

/* JUEGO 3: ENGRANAJES */
@keyframes gearSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes gearSpinCCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(-360deg); }
}

.gear-rotatable {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.gear-spin-cw {
  animation: gearSpinCW 2.6s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-ccw {
  animation: gearSpinCCW 2.6s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-cw-fast {
  animation: gearSpinCW 1.5s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-ccw-slow {
  animation: gearSpinCCW 4.5s linear infinite;
}

/* Recompensas finales */
.ia-rewards-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  margin: 20px 0;
}

.ia-reward-card {
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.14);
}

.ia-reward-card.is-earned {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFDF5 0%, #FFEFA6 100%);
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
}

.ia-reward-icon {
  font-size: 2.6rem;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.ia-reward-name {
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}

.ia-reward-status {
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
}

/* Integración visual de las cajas e iDevices nativos de eXeLearning */
article.box {
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

article.box > .box-head {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo) !important;
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0 !important;
  padding: 12px 20px !important;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
}

article.box > .box-head .box-title {
  color: var(--ia-amarillo) !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  font-size: 1.25rem !important;
}

.idevice_node.form,
.idevice_node.relate,
.idevice_node.trueorfalse,
.idevice_node.scrambled-list {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-top: none;
  border-radius: 0 0 22px 22px;
  padding: 24px 28px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.14);
}

@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .ia-page-title {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
  }
  .ia-card,
  .ia-game-box {
    padding: 16px;
  }
  .ia-btn {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

</style>

odePagStructure.blockName: Actividad de ordenación: Secuencia de los engranajes

odeComponent.htmlView:
Ordena paso a paso cómo se transmite el movimiento en un tren de tres engranajes y pulsa COMPROBAR:

  • 1. El engranaje motor comienza a girar.
  • 2. El segundo engranaje gira en sentido contrario.
  • 3. El tercer engranaje recibe el movimiento del segundo.

COMPROBAR

¡Orden correcto! Así se transmite el movimiento desde el engranaje motor hasta el tercero.

Revisa qué engranaje inicia el movimiento y cuál lo recibe después.

odeComponent.htmlView:
<div class="exe-text-template">
    <style>
/* ==========================================================================
   INVENTORES EN ACCIÓN: EL MUNDO DE LAS MÁQUINAS SIMPLES
   Sistema de Diseño Editorial de Taller de Inventos (6.° y 7.° Grado)
   Paleta conceptual oficial:
   - Azul petróleo: #173B57 (Elementos estructurales y títulos)
   - Turquesa:      #39B8AE (Interacción y elementos destacados)
   - Amarillo:      #FFC857 (Descubrimientos y recompensas)
   - Naranja:       #F28C45 (Acciones y elementos importantes)
   - Crema:         #FFF8E9 (Fondos cálidos)
   - Blanco:        #FFFFFF (Áreas de lectura)
   - Gris oscuro:   #303943 (Texto)
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --ia-petroleo: #173B57;
  --ia-petroleo-dark: #0F283C;
  --ia-petroleo-mid: #214F73;
  --ia-turquesa: #39B8AE;
  --ia-turquesa-soft: #E5F7F5;
  --ia-amarillo: #FFC857;
  --ia-amarillo-soft: #FFF4D4;
  --ia-naranja: #F28C45;
  --ia-naranja-soft: #FDECE0;
  --ia-crema: #FFF8E9;
  --ia-crema-warm: #F6EAD1;
  --ia-blanco: #FFFFFF;
  --ia-texto: #303943;
  --ia-borde: #C7D8E6;
  --ia-font: 'Segoe UI', 'Nunito', 'Rubik', 'Trebuchet MS', system-ui, sans-serif;
}

/* Fondo general con textura sutil de mesa y plano de taller (nunca blanco plano ni un único color uniforme) */
html,
body,
.exe-export,
#exe-content,
.exe-content,
main,
.container {
  background-color: var(--ia-crema) !important;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 10%, rgba(255, 200, 87, 0.16) 0%, transparent 35%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 85%, rgba(57, 184, 174, 0.14) 0%, transparent 40%),
    linear-gradient(rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px) !important;
  background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 32px 32px, 32px 32px !important;
  color: var(--ia-texto) !important;
  font-family: var(--ia-font) !important;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.58;
}

/* Enlace accesible de salto al contenido */
.ia-skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -120px;
  left: 16px;
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  z-index: 9999;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.ia-skip-link:focus {
  top: 14px;
}

/* Indicador de foco accesible para navegación por teclado */
a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
summary:focus-visible,
[tabindex]:focus-visible {
  outline: 4px solid var(--ia-naranja) !important;
  outline-offset: 3px !important;
}

/* Cabecera del paquete y menú lateral/superior de eXeLearning */
.main-header,
header#header,
.exe-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 65%, var(--ia-petroleo-mid) 100%) !important;
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  border-bottom: 5px solid var(--ia-amarillo) !important;
  border-radius: 0 0 22px 22px;
  padding: 18px 24px !important;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.18);
}

.package-title,
header#header h1 {
  color: var(--ia-amarillo) !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  font-size: 1.85rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  margin: 0 0 4px !important;
}

.package-subtitle {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 1.05rem !important;
  opacity: 0.95;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.page-header .page-title {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  background: rgba(57, 184, 174, 0.22);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: 1.35rem !important;
  margin-top: 12px !important;
}

#siteNav {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo) !important;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

#siteNav ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

#siteNav a {
  color: var(--ia-blanco) !important;
  font-weight: 800;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 9px 14px !important;
  display: inline-block;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.12s ease;
}

#siteNav a:hover,
#siteNav li.active > a,
#siteNav a.active {
  background-color: var(--ia-turquesa) !important;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

/* Contenedor editorial del taller */
.ia-taller-wrap {
  max-width: 980px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 8px 12px 28px;
}

/* Barra superior de progreso, estrellas e insignias */
.ia-topbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 100%);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  padding: 14px 22px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 0 rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.24);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.ia-brand {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ia-brand-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.ia-brand-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  color: #E5F7F5;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ia-progress-summary {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-star-pill {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  padding: 7px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-blanco);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.ia-badges-mini {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.ia-badge-chip {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  color: #D9E8F5;
  border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

.ia-badge-chip.is-unlocked {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
}

/* Escenarios de historia y lectura del taller */
.ia-card {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 26px 30px;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.14);
  position: relative;
}

.ia-card--highlight {
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #FFFDF7 100%);
}

/* Etiqueta de estación / personaje secundario */
.ia-station-banner {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--ia-petroleo);
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.ia-page-title {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 2.05rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.ia-section-title {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-lead-text {
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
  margin: 0 0 14px;
}

.ia-question-call {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-naranja);
  margin: 12px 0 18px;
}

/* Marco escénico de ilustraciones */
.ia-illustration-box {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ia-crema) 0%, var(--ia-crema-warm) 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 14px;
  margin: 16px 0 20px;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.08);
}

.ia-illustration-box img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 14px;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Tarjetas comparativas de conceptos */
.ia-concept-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(270px, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 16px;
}

.ia-concept-item {
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  border-left: 8px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
}

.ia-concept-item strong {
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   BARRA DE AUDIO ACCESIBLE CON VERIFICACIÓN DE VOZ EN ESPAÑOL
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-audio-bar {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-turquesa-soft) 0%, var(--ia-crema) 100%);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-turquesa);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  margin: 16px 0;
}

.ia-audio-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.ia-audio-label {
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ia-audio-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ia-btn-audio {
  background: var(--ia-petroleo);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 9px 16px;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.ia-btn-audio:hover {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ia-btn-audio--play {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-audio-status {
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.ia-transcripcion {
  margin-top: 10px;
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-borde);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
}

.ia-transcripcion summary {
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.ia-transcripcion p {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  color: var(--ia-texto);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   BOTONES TÁCTILES DEL TALLER
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--ia-font);
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 14px 26px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: transform 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease, background-color 0.14s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(2px);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.52;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.ia-btn--primary {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--warning {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--orange {
  background: var(--ia-naranja);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-btn--secondary {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark) !important;
}

.ia-nav-footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 3px dashed var(--ia-borde);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   CONSOLA DE JUEGOS INTERACTIVOS DEL TALLER + COMPAÑERO LEO CON 4 EXPRESIONES
   ========================================================================== */
.ia-game-box {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #FFFDF8 100%);
  border: 4px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 26px;
  padding: 26px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 0 rgba(15, 40, 60, 0.2);
}

.ia-game-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ia-petroleo-dark) 0%, var(--ia-petroleo) 100%);
  color: var(--ia-blanco);
  padding: 16px 22px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  border-bottom: 4px solid var(--ia-amarillo);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-game-title {
  font-size: 1.42rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-amarillo);
  margin: 0;
}

.ia-game-step-badge {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  font-weight: 900;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--ia-blanco);
}

/* Barra de compañero narrativo (Leo + Especialista de nivel) */
.ia-character-coach {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  background: var(--ia-amarillo-soft);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-naranja);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.ia-coach-avatar {
  flex: 0 0 64px;
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.ia-coach-bubble {
  flex: 1;
}

.ia-coach-name {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-naranja);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  display: block;
}

.ia-coach-text {
  font-size: 1.14rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  margin: 2px 0 0;
}

.ia-game-prompt {
  font-size: 1.22rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  background: var(--ia-crema);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-left: 8px solid var(--ia-naranja);
  padding: 14px 18px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-game-stage {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFDF7 0%, var(--ia-crema-warm) 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  text-align: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: inset 0 3px 8px rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.1);
}

.ia-game-stage svg {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Botones de selección de opciones en los juegos */
.ia-options-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(225px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.ia-option-btn {
  background: var(--ia-blanco);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  font-family: var(--ia-font);
  font-size: 1.08rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: center;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(23, 59, 87, 0.18);
}

.ia-option-btn:hover {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo-soft);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ia-option-btn.is-selected {
  background: var(--ia-amarillo);
  border-color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-option-btn img {
  max-width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto 8px;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.ia-game-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

/* Mensajes de retroalimentación */
.ia-feedback-box {
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  border: 3px solid var(--ia-petroleo);
  text-align: center;
}

.ia-feedback-box.is-success {
  background: var(--ia-turquesa-soft);
  border-color: var(--ia-turquesa);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-feedback-box.is-error {
  background: var(--ia-naranja-soft);
  border-color: var(--ia-naranja);
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-badge-unlocked-banner {
  margin-top: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ia-amarillo) 0%, #FFE28A 100%);
  border: 3.5px solid var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--ia-petroleo-dark);
}

.ia-badge-unlocked-banner h4 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ANIMACIONES REALES DE MECANISMOS (SVG / CSS)
   ========================================================================== */
.palanca-beam-group,
.palanca-box-group,
.palanca-fulcrum-group,
.palanca-effort-group {
  transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.palanca-beam-group {
  transform-origin: 240px 175px;
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-beam-group {
  transform: rotate(10deg);
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-box-group {
  transform: translateY(-28px);
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-effort-group {
  transform: translateY(24px);
}

@keyframes palancaStrain {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  25% { transform: rotate(2deg); }
  50% { transform: rotate(-1.5deg); }
  75% { transform: rotate(1.5deg); }
}

.stage-palanca-fail .palanca-beam-group {
  animation: palancaStrain 0.55s ease-in-out 2;
}

/* JUEGO 2: POLEAS */
.polea-load-group,
.polea-movable-assembly,
.polea-rope-pull {
  transition: transform 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
}

@keyframes wheelSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.polea-wheel-spin {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.stage-polea-active .polea-wheel-spin {
  animation: wheelSpinCW 1.1s linear 2;
}

.stage-polea-fixed-success .polea-load-group {
  transform: translateY(-88px);
}

.stage-polea-fixed-success .polea-rope-pull {
  transform: translateY(72px);
}

.stage-polea-movable-success .polea-movable-assembly {
  transform: translateY(-88px);
}

.stage-polea-movable-success .polea-rope-pull {
  transform: translateY(-76px);
}

@keyframes poleaFailShake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  30% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
  60% { transform: translateY(0); }
}

.stage-polea-fail .polea-load-group,
.stage-polea-fail .polea-movable-assembly {
  animation: poleaFailShake 0.55s ease-in-out 2;
}

/* JUEGO 3: ENGRANAJES */
@keyframes gearSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes gearSpinCCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(-360deg); }
}

.gear-rotatable {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.gear-spin-cw {
  animation: gearSpinCW 2.6s linear infinite;
}

<p>
<script>
/* ==========================================================================
   INVENTORES EN ACCIÓN: EL MUNDO DE LAS MÁQUINAS SIMPLES
   Motor interactivo modular:
   - 3 Juegos HTML/CSS/JS independientes + Misión Final paso a paso
   - Personaje guía Leo con 4 expresiones dinámicas + Maya, Bruno y Nora
   - Reproductor de audio accesible con verificación estricta de voz en español
   - Sistema de estrellas (sin duplicados) e insignias persistentes
   ========================================================================== */

(function () {
  'use strict';

  var STORAGE_KEY = 'inventores_en_accion_state_v5';

  function getDefaultState() {
    return {
      stars: {},
      badges: {
        palancas: false,
        poleas: false,
        engranajes: false
      },
      diagnosticoDone: false,
      finalMissionScore: 0,
      finalMissionCompleted: false
    };
  }

  /* ==========================================================================
     RETRATO EXPRESIVO DE LEO (4 EXPRESIONES: descubrimiento, exito, error, felicitacion)
     ========================================================================== */
  function getLeoAvatarSvg(expression) {
    var mouthPath = 'M 24 44 Q 32 50 40 44';
    var eyeRadius = 3;
    var badgeColor = '#39B8AE';

    if (expression === 'exito') {
      mouthPath = 'M 22 42 Q 32 54 42 42 Z';
      badgeColor = '#39B8AE';
    } else if (expression === 'error') {
      mouthPath = 'M 25 46 Q 32 42 39 46';
      badgeColor = '#F28C45';
    } else if (expression === 'felicitacion') {
      mouthPath = 'M 20 41 Q 32 56 44 41 Z';
      eyeRadius = 3.5;
      badgeColor = '#FFC857';
    }

    return (
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="58" height="58" role="img" aria-label="Leo el inventor (' + expression + ')">' +
        '<circle cx="32" cy="32" r="30" fill="' + badgeColor + '" opacity="0.22"/>' +
        '<circle cx="32" cy="36" r="20" fill="#FFE0B2" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="2.5"/>' +
        '<path d="M 12 30 Q 18 10 36 12 Q 52 14 52 30 Z" fill="#173B57"/>' +
        '<rect x="13" y="18" width="38" height="12" rx="6" fill="#FFC857" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="2"/>' +
        '<circle cx="24" cy="24" r="6" fill="#39B8AE" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="1.8"/>' +
        '<circle cx="40" cy="24" r="6" fill="#39B8AE" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="1.8"/>' +
        '<circle cx="25" cy="36" r="' + eyeRadius + '" fill="#173B57"/>' +
        '<circle cx="39" cy="36" r="' + eyeRadius + '" fill="#173B57"/>' +
        '<path d="' + mouthPath + '" fill="' + (expression === 'exito' || expression === 'felicitacion' ? '#173B57' : 'none') + '" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>' +
      '</svg>'
    );
  }

  /* Generador de polígono de engranaje real con dientes trapezoidales */
  function createGearPolygonPoints(cx, cy, teeth, rOuter, rInner) {
    var pts = [];
    var step = (2 * Math.PI) / teeth;
    for (var i = 0; i < teeth; i++) {
      var a0 = i * step;
      var a1 = a0 + step * 0.15;
      var a2 = a0 + step * 0.28;
      var a3 = a0 + step * 0.58;
      var a4 = a0 + step * 0.71;
      pts.push((cx + rInner * Math.cos(a0)).toFixed(1) + ',' + (cy + rInner * Math.sin(a0)).toFixed(1));
      pts.push((cx + rInner * Math.cos(a1)).toFixed(1) + ',' + (cy + rInner * Math.sin(a1)).toFixed(1));
      pts.push((cx + rOuter * Math.cos(a2)).toFixed(1) + ',' + (cy + rOuter * Math.sin(a2)).toFixed(1));
      pts.push((cx + rOuter * Math.cos(a3)).toFixed(1) + ',' + (cy + rOuter * Math.sin(a3)).toFixed(1));
      pts.push((cx + rInner * Math.cos(a4)).toFixed(1) + ',' + (cy + rInner * Math.sin(a4)).toFixed(1));
    }
    return pts.join(' ');
  }

  /* ==========================================================================
     ESTADO GLOBAL DE PUNTUACIÓN, ESTRELLAS E INSIGNIAS
     ========================================================================== */
  var AppState = {
    data: getDefaultState(),

    load: function () {
      try {
        var raw = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (raw) {
          var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
            this.data.stars = parsed.stars || {};
            this.data.badges = parsed.badges || { palancas: false, poleas: false, engranajes: false };
            this.data.diagnosticoDone = !!parsed.diagnosticoDone;
            this.data.finalMissionScore = typeof parsed.finalMissionScore === 'number' ? parsed.finalMissionScore : 0;
            this.data.finalMissionCompleted = !!parsed.finalMissionCompleted;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        this.data = getDefaultState();
      }
      this.renderTopBar();
    },

    save: function () {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.data));
      } catch (e) {
        /* Almacenamiento local restringido */
      }
      this.renderTopBar();
    },

    awardStar: function (starId) {
      if (!starId) return false;
      var isNew = !this.data.stars[starId];
      this.data.stars[starId] = true;
      this.save();
      return isNew;
    },

    unlockBadge: function (badgeKey) {
      if (!badgeKey) return;
      this.data.badges[badgeKey] = true;
      this.save();
    },

    getStarCount: function () {
      return Object.keys(this.data.stars || {}).length;
    },

    resetAll: function () {
      this.data = getDefaultState();
      this.save();
    },

    renderTopBar: function () {
      var starCountEls = document.querySelectorAll('#ia-star-count, .js-ia-star-count');
      var countStr = String(this.getStarCount());
      starCountEls.forEach(function (el) {
        el.textContent = countStr;
      });

      var badgePalancas = document.getElementById('ia-chip-palancas');
      if (badgePalancas) badgePalancas.classList.toggle('is-unlocked', !!this.data.badges.palancas);

      var badgePoleas = document.getElementById('ia-chip-poleas');
      if (badgePoleas) badgePoleas.classList.toggle('is-unlocked', !!this.data.badges.poleas);

      var badgeEngranajes = document.getElementById('ia-chip-engranajes');
      if (badgeEngranajes) badgeEngranajes.classList.toggle('is-unlocked', !!this.data.badges.engranajes);
    }
  };

  /* ==========================================================================
     REPRODUCTOR DE AUDIO Y SÍNTESIS DE VOZ ESTRICTA EN ESPAÑOL (PARTE VI)
     ========================================================================== */
  var ControladorAudio = {
    delegatedBound: false,
    spanishVoice: null,
    voicesLoaded: false,

    initVoices: function () {
      var self = this;
      if (!('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;

      function pickSpanishVoice() {
        var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
        if (!voices.length) return;
        self.voicesLoaded = true;

        // 1. Priorizar es-CO nativa
        var esCO = voices.find(function (v) { return /^es[-_]CO/i.test(v.lang); });
        // 2. Priorizar español latinoamericano
        var esLatam = voices.find(function (v) { return /^es[-_](MX|419|AR|CL|PE|VE|EC|UY)/i.test(v.lang); });
        // 3. Cualquier otra voz nativa cuyo código de idioma real empiece por 'es'
        var esAny = voices.find(function (v) { return /^es([-_]|$)/i.test(v.lang); });

        self.spanishVoice = esCO || esLatam || esAny || null;
      }

      pickSpanishVoice();
      if (window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged !== undefined) {
        window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = pickSpanishVoice;
      }
    },

    speakFallbackSpanish: function (text, statusEl) {
      var self = this;
      if (!('speechSynthesis' in window)) {
        if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Audio no disponible en este visor. Consulta la transcripción textual.';
        return;
      }

      this.initVoices();
      if (!this.spanishVoice) {
        // Prohibido usar una voz inglesa para leer español
        if (statusEl) {
          statusEl.textContent = 'Aviso: No se encontró una voz nativa en español en este sistema. Lee la transcripción desplegable.';
        }
        return;
      }

      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      var utter = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
      utter.voice = this.spanishVoice;
      utter.lang = this.spanishVoice.lang || 'es-CO';
      utter.rate = 0.98;
      utter.onstart = function () {
        if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Reproduciendo narración en español (' + self.spanishVoice.name + ')...';
      };
      utter.onend = function () {
        if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Narración finalizada. Pulsa REPETIR si deseas escucharla de nuevo.';
      };
      window.speechSynthesis.speak(utter);
    },

    playBar: function (bar, restart) {
      var self = this;
      if (!bar) return;
      var audio = bar.querySelector('audio');
      var statusEl = bar.querySelector('.ia-audio-status');
      var transcriptEl = bar.querySelector('.ia-transcripcion p');
      var transcriptText = transcriptEl ? transcriptEl.textContent : '';

      // Pausar otros audios activos
      document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(function (other) {
        if (other !== audio && !other.paused) {
          other.pause();
        }
      });
      if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      }

      if (!audio) {
        this.speakFallbackSpanish(transcriptText, statusEl);
        return;
      }

      if (restart) {
        try { audio.currentTime = 0; } catch (e) {}
      }

      var fileName = bar.getAttribute('data-audio-file') || (audio.getAttribute('src') || '').split('/').pop();
      var candidates = [
        audio.getAttribute('src'),
        'content/resources/' + fileName,
        '../content/resources/' + fileName,
        'resources/' + fileName,
        fileName
      ].filter(Boolean);

      function tryPlayCandidate(idx) {
        if (idx >= candidates.length) {
          self.speakFallbackSpanish(transcriptText, statusEl);
          return;
        }
        var currentSrc = audio.getAttribute('src');
        if (idx > 0 && candidates[idx] !== currentSrc) {
          audio.setAttribute('src', candidates[idx]);
          audio.load();
        }
        var p = audio.play();
        if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = restart ? 'Repitiendo narración en español desde el inicio...' : 'Reproduciendo narración en español...';
        if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') {
          p.catch(function () {
            tryPlayCandidate(idx + 1);
          });
        }
      }

      tryPlayCandidate(0);
    },

    pauseBar: function (bar) {
      if (!bar) return;
      var audio = bar.querySelector('audio');
      var statusEl = bar.querySelector('.ia-audio-status');
      if (audio && !audio.paused) {
        audio.pause();
      }
      if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.pause();
      }
      if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Audio en pausa. Pulsa REPRODUCIR para continuar.';
    },

    init: function () {
      var self = this;
      this.initVoices();

      if (!this.delegatedBound) {
        this.delegatedBound = true;
        document.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
          var btn = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('[data-audio-action]') : null;
          if (!btn) return;
          var bar = btn.closest('.ia-audio-bar');
          var action = btn.getAttribute('data-audio-action');
          if (action === 'play') {
            self.playBar(bar, false);
          } else if (action === 'pause') {
            self.pauseBar(bar);
          } else if (action === 'restart') {
            self.playBar(bar, true);
          }
        });
      }

      document.querySelectorAll('.ia-audio-bar audio').forEach(function (audio) {
        if (audio.getAttribute('data-ia-bound') === '1') return;
        audio.setAttribute('data-ia-bound', '1');
        audio.addEventListener('ended', function () {
          var bar = audio.closest('.ia-audio-bar');
          var statusEl = bar ? bar.querySelector('.ia-audio-status') : null;
          if (statusEl) {
            statusEl.textContent = 'Narración finalizada. Pulsa REPETIR si deseas escucharla otra vez.';
          }
        });
      });
    }
  };

  /* ==========================================================================
     BOTÓN COMENZAR AVENTURA Y DIAGNÓSTICO DE BIENVENIDA (PÁGINA 1)
     ========================================================================== */
  var ControladorInicio = {
    init: function () {
      var btnComenzar = document.getElementById('btn-comenzar-aventura');
      if (btnComenzar && btnComenzar.getAttribute('data-ia-bound') !== '1') {
        btnComenzar.setAttribute('data-ia-bound', '1');
        btnComenzar.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
          var diagSection = document.getElementById('seccion-diagnostico-inicial') || document.getElementById('box-inicio-2');
          if (diagSection) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            diagSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
            var firstInput = diagSection.querySelector('button, input, a');
            if (firstInput) firstInput.focus();
          }
        });
      }
    }
  };

  /* ==========================================================================
     JUEGO 1: ¡LEVANTA LA CAJA! (NIVEL 1 - PALANCAS)
     ========================================================================== */
  var JuegoPalancas = {
    container: null,
    currentStep: 0,
    selectedOption: null,
    leoMood: 'descubrimiento',
    coachMsg: 'Maya y yo necesitamos levantar esta caja de 100 kg. ¡Elige una opción y pulsa PROBAR!',
    stepCompleted: [false, false, false],

    challenges: [
      {
        id: 'palanca_reto_1',
        badgeText: 'Reto 1 de 3 · Encuentra el punto de apoyo',
        prompt: '¿Qué posición del punto de apoyo permite levantar la carga con menor esfuerzo si aplicamos la fuerza en el extremo contrario?',
        options: [
          { text: 'Cerca de la carga.', correct: true, fulcrumX: 235 },
          { text: 'En el centro de la barra.', correct: false, fulcrumX: 360 },
          { text: 'Lejos de la carga.', correct: false, fulcrumX: 485 }
        ],
        successMsg: '¡Lo lograste! Al colocar el punto de apoyo cerca de la carga, la barra multiplica tu fuerza y la caja se eleva.',
        errorMsg: '¡Inténtalo de nuevo! Si alejas el punto de apoyo de la carga, necesitarás mucha más fuerza para moverla.'
      },
      {
        id: 'palanca_reto_2',
        badgeText: 'Reto 2 de 3 · Construye la palanca',
        prompt: 'Construye la palanca: elige la posición correcta del punto de apoyo para levantar esta nueva caja pesada:',
        options: [
          { text: 'Posición A: Punto de apoyo junto a la carga.', correct: true, fulcrumX: 235 },
          { text: 'Posición B: Punto de apoyo en el centro.', correct: false, fulcrumX: 360 },
          { text: 'Posición C: Punto de apoyo junto a la fuerza.', correct: false, fulcrumX: 485 }
        ],
        successMsg: '¡Palanca construida con éxito! El punto de apoyo junto a la carga levanta la caja con facilidad.',
        errorMsg: '¡Esa posición no logra levantar la caja! Observa dónde está situada la carga y vuelve a intentarlo.'
      },
      {
        id: 'palanca_reto_3',
        badgeText: 'Reto 3 de 3 · Identifica los elementos',
        prompt: 'Observa la ilustración de la palanca. ¿Cuál de los elementos señalados es el punto de apoyo sobre el que gira la barra?',
        options: [
          { text: 'La caja pesada situada a la izquierda (Carga).', correct: false, fulcrumX: 235 },
          { text: 'El soporte triangular debajo de la barra (El punto de apoyo).', correct: true, fulcrumX: 235 },
          { text: 'El empuje hacia abajo en el extremo derecho (Fuerza).', correct: false, fulcrumX: 235 }
        ],
        successMsg: '¡Excelente identificación! El soporte triangular es el punto de apoyo sobre el que gira toda la barra.',
        errorMsg: '¡Casi! Recuerda que el punto de apoyo es la pieza fija debajo de la barra que le permite girar.'
      }
    ],

    init: function () {
      this.container = document.getElementById('juego-palancas');
      if (!this.container) return;
      this.render();
    },

    getStageSvg: function (fulcrumX) {

      var optionsHtml = ch.options.map(function (opt, idx) {

    bindEvents: function () {

      this.container.querySelectorAll('.ia-option-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          self.selectedOption = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-opt-index'), 10);
          self.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
          self.coachMsg = 'Opción seleccionada. ¡Ahora pulsa PROBAR para accionar la palanca!';
          self.render();
        });
      });

      var btnProbar = document.getElementById('btn-palanca-probar');
      if (btnProbar) {
        btnProbar.addEventListener('click', function () { self.comprobar(); });
      }

      var btnReintentar = document.getElementById('btn-palanca-reintentar');
      if (btnReintentar) {
        btnReintentar.addEventListener('click', function () { self.reiniciar(); });
      }

      var btnSiguiente = document.getElementById('btn-palanca-siguiente');
      if (btnSiguiente) {
        btnSiguiente.addEventListener('click', function () {
          if (self.currentStep < self.challenges.length - 1) {
            self.currentStep += 1;
            self.selectedOption = null;
            self.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
            self.coachMsg = '¡Nuevo reto listo! Analiza la posición del punto de apoyo y pulsa PROBAR.';
            self.render();
          }
        });
      }

    comprobar: function () {
      var ch = this.challenges[this.currentStep];
      if (this.selectedOption === null) {
        this.leoMood = 'error';
        this.coachMsg = 'Selecciona primero una de las opciones antes de pulsar PROBAR.';
        this.render();
        var fbEmpty = document.getElementById('palanca-feedback');
        if (fbEmpty) fbEmpty.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-error">Elige una opción y luego pulsa PROBAR.</div>';
        return;
      }

      var chosen = ch.options[this.selectedOption];
      if (chosen && chosen.correct) {
        this.stepCompleted[this.currentStep] = true;
        AppState.awardStar(ch.id);
        var allDone = this.stepCompleted[0] && this.stepCompleted[1] && this.stepCompleted[2];
        if (allDone) {
          AppState.unlockBadge('palancas');
          this.leoMood = 'felicitacion';
          this.coachMsg = '¡Increíble! Completaste los 3 retos y ganaste la insignia EXPERTO EN PALANCAS.';
        } else {
          this.leoMood = 'exito';
          this.coachMsg = '¡Genial! Observa cómo se inclina la barra y se eleva la caja.';
        }
        this.render();
        var stage = document.getElementById('palanca-stage');
        var fb = document.getElementById('palanca-feedback');
        if (stage) {
          void stage.offsetWidth;
          stage.classList.add('stage-palanca-success');
        }
        if (fb) {
          fb.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-success">⭐ ' + ch.successMsg + '</div>';
        }
      } else {
        this.leoMood = 'error';
        this.coachMsg = '¡Casi! Prueba acercando el punto de apoyo a la carga y vuelve a pulsar PROBAR.';
        this.render();
        var stageErr = document.getElementById('palanca-stage');
        var fbErr = document.getElementById('palanca-feedback');
        if (stageErr) {
          void stageErr.offsetWidth;
          stageErr.classList.add('stage-palanca-fail');
        }
        if (fbErr) {
          fbErr.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-error">' + ch.errorMsg + '</div>';
        }
      }
    },

      this.selectedOption = null;
      this.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
      this.coachMsg = 'Escenario reiniciado. Selecciona una opción y pulsa PROBAR.';
      this.render();
    }
  };

    init: function () {

      if (!this.container) return;
      this.render();

    renderToothedGearGroup: function (cx, cy, teeth, rOuter, rInner, fill, animClass, label) {
      var polyPoints = createGearPolygonPoints(cx, cy, teeth, rOuter, rInner);
      return (
        '<g class="gear-rotatable ' + (animClass || '') + '">' +
          '<polygon points="' + polyPoints + '" fill="' + fill + '" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
          '<line x1="' + (cx - rInner + 8) + '" y1="' + cy + '" x2="' + (cx + rInner - 8) + '" y2="' + cy + '" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
          '<line x1="' + cx + '" y1="' + (cy - rInner + 8) + '" x2="' + cx + '" y2="' + (cy + rInner - 8) + '" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
          '<circle cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="' + Math.round(rInner * 0.32) + '" fill="#FFF8E9" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
        '</g>' +
        (label ? '<text x="' + cx + '" y="' + (cy + rOuter + 24) + '" text-anchor="middle" fill="#173B57" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">' + label + '</text>' : '')
      );
    },

    getStageSvg: function (ch) {
      var spin = this.isSpinning;
      if (ch.sceneType === 'two_contact') {
        var g1Anim = spin ? 'gear-spin-cw' : '';
        var g2Anim = spin ? 'gear-spin-ccw' : '';
        return (
          '<svg viewBox="0 0 720 265" width="720" height="265" role="img" aria-label="Dos engranajes con dientes visibles en contacto directo.">' +
            '<rect width="720" height="265" rx="16" fill="#FFF8E9"/>' +
            '<rect x="95" y="20" width="530" height="225" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
            this.renderToothedGearGroup(292, 122, 12, 66, 52, '#39B8AE', g1Anim, '1. MOTOR (Derecha ↻)') +
            this.renderToothedGearGroup(418, 122, 12, 66, 52, '#F28C45', g2Anim, '2. ENGRANAJE EN CONTACTO') +
          '</svg>'
        );
      }

      if (ch.sceneType === 'connect_slot') {
        var middleConnected = this.selectedOption !== 1;
        var midY = middleConnected ? 122 : 52;
        var motorAnim = spin ? 'gear-spin-cw' : '';
        var midAnim = (spin && middleConnected) ? 'gear-spin-ccw' : '';
        var outAnim = (spin && middleConnected) ? 'gear-spin-cw' : '';
        var machineLight = (spin && middleConnected) ? '#39B8AE' : '#D5E2EC';
        var machineText = (spin && middleConnected) ? '¡FÁBRICA ACTIVA!' : 'EN ESPERA';

        return (
          '<svg viewBox="0 0 720 265" width="720" height="265" role="img" aria-label="Sistema de tres engranajes con dientes conectando el motor y la máquina de la fábrica.">' +
            '<rect width="720" height="265" rx="16" fill="#FFF8E9"/>' +
            '<rect x="40" y="20" width="640" height="225" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
            '<circle cx="305" cy="122" r="50" fill="none" stroke="#39B8AE" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="7,5"/>' +
            this.renderToothedGearGroup(192, 122, 11, 58, 45, '#39B8AE', motorAnim, '1. MOTOR') +
            this.renderToothedGearGroup(305, midY, 10, 54, 42, '#FFC857', midAnim, middleConnected ? '2. CONECTADO' : '2. SEPARADO') +
            this.renderToothedGearGroup(418, 122, 11, 58, 45, '#F28C45', outAnim, '3. SALIDA') +
            '<rect x="515" y="68" width="135" height="108" rx="14" fill="#173B57"/>' +
            '<circle cx="582" cy="108" r="20" fill="' + machineLight + '" stroke="#FFF8E9" stroke-width="3"/>' +
            '<text x="582" y="154" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFC857" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">' + machineText + '</text>' +
          '</svg>'
        );
      }

      var smallAnim = spin ? 'gear-spin-cw-fast' : '';
      var largeAnim = spin ? 'gear-spin-ccw-slow' : '';
      return (
        '<svg viewBox="0 0 720 265" width="720" height="265" role="img" aria-label="Engranaje pequeño moviendo un engranaje grande con dientes visibles.">' +
          '<rect width="720" height="265" rx="16" fill="#FFF8E9"/>' +
          '<rect x="95" y="18" width="530" height="228" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#173B57" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
          this.renderToothedGearGroup(272, 122, 8, 44, 33, '#FFC857', smallAnim, 'PEQUEÑO (Rápido ↻)') +
          this.renderToothedGearGroup(396, 122, 16, 82, 68, '#39B8AE', largeAnim, 'GRANDE (Más lento ↺)') +
        '</svg>'
      );
    },

    render: function () {
      if (!this.container) return;
      var self = this;
      var ch = this.challenges[this.currentStep];

      var optionsHtml = ch.options.map(function (opt, idx) {
        var selClass = self.selectedOption === idx ? ' is-selected' : '';
        var pressed = self.selectedOption === idx ? 'true' : 'false';
        return (
          '<button type="button" class="ia-option-btn' + selClass + '" data-opt-index="' + idx + '" aria-pressed="' + pressed + '">' +
            opt.text +
          '</button>'
        );
      }).join('');

      var allDone = this.stepCompleted[0] && this.stepCompleted[1] && this.stepCompleted[2];
      var badgeBanner = allDone ? (
        '<div class="ia-badge-unlocked-banner" role="status">' +
          '<h4>🏅 ¡Insignia obtenida: EXPERTO EN ENGRANAJES!</h4>' +
          '<p>Has puesto en marcha toda la fábrica junto a Nora y Leo.</p>' +
        '</div>'
      ) : '';

      this.container.innerHTML =
        '<div class="ia-game-header">' +
          '<h3 class="ia-game-title">⚙️ JUEGO 3: ¡ACTIVA LA FÁBRICA!</h3>' +
          '<span class="ia-game-step-badge">' + ch.badgeText + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-character-coach">' +
          '<div class="ia-coach-avatar">' + getLeoAvatarSvg(this.leoMood) + '</div>' +
          '<div class="ia-coach-bubble">' +
            '<span class="ia-coach-name">Leo y Nora · Fábrica de Engranajes</span>' +
            '<p class="ia-coach-text">' + this.coachMsg + '</p>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-game-prompt">' + ch.prompt + '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-game-stage" id="engranaje-stage">' +
          this.getStageSvg(ch) +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-options-grid" role="group" aria-label="Opciones del reto de engranajes">' +
          optionsHtml +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ia-game-actions">' +
          '<button type="button" class="ia-btn ia-btn--primary" id="btn-engranaje-probar">ENCENDER FÁBRICA</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="ia-btn ia-btn--secondary" id="btn-engranaje-reintentar">REINTENTAR</button>' +
          (this.currentStep < this.challenges.length - 1
            ? '<button type="button" class="ia-btn ia-btn--warning" id="btn-engranaje-siguiente" ' + (this.stepCompleted[this.currentStep] ? '' : 'disabled') + '>SIGUIENTE RETO</button>'
            : '') +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="engranaje-feedback" aria-live="polite"></div>' +
        badgeBanner;

      this.bindEvents();
    },

    bindEvents: function () {
      var self = this;
      this.container.querySelectorAll('.ia-option-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          self.selectedOption = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-opt-index'), 10);
          self.isSpinning = false;
          self.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
          self.coachMsg = 'Configuración seleccionada. ¡Pulsa ENCENDER FÁBRICA para probar el giro!';
          self.render();
        });
      });

      var btnProbar = document.getElementById('btn-engranaje-probar');
      if (btnProbar) {
        btnProbar.addEventListener('click', function () { self.comprobar(); });
      }

      var btnReintentar = document.getElementById('btn-engranaje-reintentar');
      if (btnReintentar) {
        btnReintentar.addEventListener('click', function () { self.reiniciar(); });
      }

      var btnSiguiente = document.getElementById('btn-engranaje-siguiente');
      if (btnSiguiente) {
        btnSiguiente.addEventListener('click', function () {
          if (self.currentStep < self.challenges.length - 1) {
            self.currentStep += 1;
            self.selectedOption = null;
            self.isSpinning = false;
            self.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
            self.coachMsg = '¡Siguiente reto de engranajes! Observa el tamaño y la conexión de las ruedas.';
            self.render();
          }
        });
      }
    },

    comprobar: function () {
      var ch = this.challenges[this.currentStep];
      if (this.selectedOption === null) {
        this.leoMood = 'error';
        this.coachMsg = 'Elige primero una opción antes de pulsar ENCENDER FÁBRICA.';
        this.render();
        var fbEmpty = document.getElementById('engranaje-feedback');
        if (fbEmpty) fbEmpty.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-error">Selecciona una opción antes de encender la fábrica.</div>';
        return;
      }

      var chosen = ch.options[this.selectedOption];
      if (chosen && chosen.correct) {
        this.isSpinning = true;
        this.stepCompleted[this.currentStep] = true;
        AppState.awardStar(ch.id);
        var allDone = this.stepCompleted[0] && this.stepCompleted[1] && this.stepCompleted[2];
        if (allDone) {
          AppState.unlockBadge('engranajes');
          this.leoMood = 'felicitacion';
          this.coachMsg = '¡Fábrica en marcha al 100%! Desbloqueaste la insignia EXPERTO EN ENGRANAJES.';
        } else {
          this.leoMood = 'exito';
          this.coachMsg = '¡Mira cómo encajan los dientes y giran las ruedas!';
        }
        this.render();
        var fbAfter = document.getElementById('engranaje-feedback');
        if (fbAfter) {
          fbAfter.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-success">⭐ ' + ch.successMsg + '</div>';
        }
      } else {
        this.isSpinning = false;
        this.leoMood = 'error';
        this.coachMsg = '¡Revisa el contacto y los dientes de las ruedas e inténtalo de nuevo!';
        this.render();
        var fbErr = document.getElementById('engranaje-feedback');
        if (fbErr) {
          fbErr.innerHTML = '<div class="ia-feedback-box is-error">' + ch.errorMsg + '</div>';
        }
      }
    },

    reiniciar: function () {
      this.selectedOption = null;
      this.isSpinning = false;
      this.leoMood = 'descubrimiento';
      this.coachMsg = 'Engranajes detenidos. Elige una opción y pulsa ENCENDER FÁBRICA.';
      this.render();
    }
  };

      var bPalancas = !!AppState.data.badges.palancas;
      var bPoleas = !!AppState.data.badges.poleas;
      var bEngranajes = !!AppState.data.badges.engranajes;
      var missionScore = AppState.data.finalMissionScore || 0;

      var starsEl = document.getElementById('ia-final-stars-total');
      if (starsEl) {
        starsEl.textContent = totalStars + ' de 12 estrellas obtenidas en el taller';
      }

      var missionEl = document.getElementById('ia-final-mission-status');
      if (missionEl) {
        missionEl.textContent = missionScore === 3
          ? '¡Increíble! Has superado los 3 retos de la Misión Final y salvado el taller.'
          : 'Estrellas de la Misión Final: ' + missionScore + ' de 3.';
      }

      this.updateBadgeCard('card-badge-palancas', bPalancas);
      this.updateBadgeCard('card-badge-poleas', bPoleas);
      this.updateBadgeCard('card-badge-engranajes', bEngranajes);

      var btnResetPlay = document.getElementById('btn-volver-a-jugar');
      if (btnResetPlay && btnResetPlay.getAttribute('data-ia-bound') !== '1') {
        btnResetPlay.setAttribute('data-ia-bound', '1');
        btnResetPlay.addEventListener('click', function () {
          AppState.resetAll();
          var isRoot = window.location.pathname.indexOf('/html/') === -1 && window.location.pathname.indexOf('\\html\\') === -1;
          window.location.href = isRoot ? 'index.html' : '../index.html';
        });
      }
    },

    updateBadgeCard: function (id, unlocked) {
      var card = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!card) return;
      card.classList.toggle('is-earned', unlocked);
      var status = card.querySelector('.ia-reward-status');
      if (status) {
        status.textContent = unlocked ? '¡Insignia desbloqueada!' : 'Supera los 3 retos del nivel para ganarla';
      }
    }
  };

  /* ==========================================================================
     INICIALIZACIÓN UNIVERSAL Y OBSERVADOR DE RE-RENDERIZADO DE EXELEARNING
     ========================================================================== */
  function bootAll() {
    AppState.load();
    ControladorAudio.init();
    ControladorInicio.init();
    JuegoPalancas.init();
    JuegoPoleas.init();
    JuegoEngranajes.init();
    GranMisionFinal.init();
    PantallaFinalExperto.init();
  }

  window.InventoresApp = {
    bootAll: bootAll,
    AppState: AppState,
    ControladorAudio: ControladorAudio,
    JuegoPalancas: JuegoPalancas,
    JuegoPoleas: JuegoPoleas,
    JuegoEngranajes: JuegoEngranajes,
    GranMisionFinal: GranMisionFinal,
    PantallaFinalExperto: PantallaFinalExperto
  };

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bootAll);
  } else {
    bootAll();
  }

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    setTimeout(bootAll, 120);
    setTimeout(bootAll, 450);
  });
})();

</script>
</p>

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-beam-group {
  transform: rotate(10deg);
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-box-group {
  transform: translateY(-28px);
}

.stage-palanca-success .palanca-effort-group {
  transform: translateY(24px);
}

@keyframes palancaStrain {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  25% { transform: rotate(2deg); }
  50% { transform: rotate(-1.5deg); }
  75% { transform: rotate(1.5deg); }
}

.stage-palanca-fail .palanca-beam-group {
  animation: palancaStrain 0.55s ease-in-out 2;
}

/* JUEGO 2: POLEAS */
.polea-load-group,
.polea-movable-assembly,
.polea-rope-pull {
  transition: transform 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
}

@keyframes wheelSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.polea-wheel-spin {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.stage-polea-active .polea-wheel-spin {
  animation: wheelSpinCW 1.1s linear 2;
}

.stage-polea-fixed-success .polea-load-group {
  transform: translateY(-88px);
}

.stage-polea-fixed-success .polea-rope-pull {
  transform: translateY(72px);
}

.stage-polea-movable-success .polea-movable-assembly {
  transform: translateY(-88px);
}

.stage-polea-movable-success .polea-rope-pull {
  transform: translateY(-76px);
}

@keyframes poleaFailShake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  30% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
  60% { transform: translateY(0); }
}

.stage-polea-fail .polea-load-group,
.stage-polea-fail .polea-movable-assembly {
  animation: poleaFailShake 0.55s ease-in-out 2;
}

/* JUEGO 3: ENGRANAJES */
@keyframes gearSpinCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes gearSpinCCW {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(-360deg); }
}

.gear-rotatable {
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.gear-spin-cw {
  animation: gearSpinCW 2.6s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-ccw {
  animation: gearSpinCCW 2.6s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-cw-fast {
  animation: gearSpinCW 1.5s linear infinite;
}

.gear-spin-ccw-slow {
  animation: gearSpinCCW 4.5s linear infinite;
}

/* Recompensas finales */
.ia-rewards-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
